definitions.explanation: Good or bad chance that happens by accident.
The course of events beyond one's control.

examples.japanese: {運|うん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}かった→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
⟦{運命|うんめい}→運命：06879_unmei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{信|しん}じる→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧。
{運|うん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よければ→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{会|あ}える→会う：00482_au⟧⟦かも→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧。
examples.english: We might meet if we're lucky.

⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出会|であ}った→出会う：02298_deau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{運命|うんめい}→運命：06879_unmei⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦かもしれない→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧。
examples.english: It may have been fate that those two met.

notes:
{運|うん} means luck, fortune, or fate - chance events beyond one's control.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {運|うん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: lucky, fortunate
- {運|うん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: unlucky
- {運|うん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{試|ため}す→試す：02130_tamesu⟧: to try one's luck
- {運|うん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{任|まか}せる→任せる：02417_makaseru⟧: to leave it to fate
- {運|うん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{向|む}く→向く：02304_muku⟧: luck turns (in one's favor)
- {運|うん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{尽|つ}きる→尽きる：12365_tsukiru⟧: luck runs out

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{運命|うんめい}→運命：06879_unmei⟧: fate, destiny
- ⟦{幸運|こううん}→幸運：02725_kouun⟧: good fortune
- ⟦{不運|ふうん}→不運：00049_fuun⟧: misfortune, bad luck
- ⟦{運勢|うんせい}→運勢：15761_unsei⟧: fortune (as in horoscope)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{運|うん} plays an important role in Japanese culture, with concepts like ⟦{縁起|えんぎ}→縁起：13815_engi⟧ (omens) and fortune-telling (⟦{占|うらな}い→占い：18736_uranai⟧) being common.
